entries.title: Judges 2:1
segments: Angel of the Lord; supposed to be the same who appeared to Joshua,
Bochim; meaning, the weepers, or place of weeping.

entries.title: Judges 2:2
segments: Ye have not obeyed; they had not done it fully, or to the extent which he commanded.

entries.title: Judges 2:3
segments:
I will not drive them out; as he would have done, had they obeyed him. 
 
The rich and lasting blessings which God promises to the obedient, men often forfeit by their sins.

entries.title: Judges 2:5
segments: Sin is the cause of our sorrows, and no tears will remove them, unless we forsake it.

entries.title: Judges 2:7
segments: The pious instruction, example, and influence of the aged are of great service to the young, and often keep them from sins that would cause their ruin.

entries.title: Judges 2:10
segments:
Knew not the Lord; they had not seen his wonders in Egypt, and had not that knowledge of him which led them to love and obey him. 
 
Children, when deprived of the pious influence of parents, often become openly vicious; and nothing but the grace of God is a safeguard against abandonment in wickedness.

entries.title: Judges 2:13
segments: Ashtaroth; images of Astarte, a Phenician goddess.

entries.title: Judges 2:14
segments:
Sold; delivered. 
 
The woes which sin occasions in this life, are a warning to men not to continue in it, lest it bring upon them woes which will be eternal.

entries.title: Judges 2:16
segments:
Judges; rulers and deliverers. 
 
The blessings which God bestows upon men in this world show that he desires that they should repent of their sins, and thus be prepared for endless blessings in the world to come.

entries.title: Judges 2:18
segments: It repented the Lord; the meaning is, that he changed his course of conduct towards the Israelites, and instead of keeping them longer in bondage, delivered them.

entries.title: Judges 2:19
segments: If men are not led by the mercies of the Lord to repentance, they will become more hardened in sin, and ripen for aggravated ruin.

entries.title: Judges 2:22
segments: All the dealings of God with men in this world have a tendency to reveal their true character, show whether they will serve him or not, and prepare them for the retributions of eternity.

entries.title: Judges 2:23
segments: Therefore; on account of the sins of the people.
